en.headline: Hong Kong crypto payments firm RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO
en.dek: Bloomberg reported the unicorn is considering a year-end filing and pre-IPO talks at a valuation of US$4 billion to US$5 billion.
body: Hong Kong-based cryptocurrency payments company RedotPay is considering filing confidentially for a US initial public offering by the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.

The company is also in talks with investors about a possible pre-IPO funding round that could value it at between US$4 billion and US$5 billion. Banks including JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies and Barclays are said to be working with the firm.

RedotPay, founded in 2023 and headquartered in Central, offers physical and virtual cards that allow users to pay with cryptocurrency and stablecoins. It has reported more than 9 million users and significant payment volume across more than 100 countries.

Earlier reports this year indicated the listing plans had faced delays amid regulatory and legal issues, including a lawsuit involving Binance. The company has previously said it continues to work with partners on the process.

zh.headline: 港產加密支付獨角獸RedotPay據報考慮年底前保密赴美上市
zh.dek: 彭博引述知情人士稱，公司正商討上市前融資，估值或介乎40億至50億美元。
body: 據彭博引述知情人士報道，香港加密貨幣支付公司RedotPay正考慮在今年底前以保密方式向美國提交首次公開招股申請。
公司同時與投資者商討可能的上市前融資，估值介乎40億至50億美元。據報正與摩根大通、高盛、傑富瑞及巴克萊等銀行合作。
RedotPay於2023年成立，總部位於中環，提供實體及虛擬加密支付卡，讓用戶以加密貨幣及穩定幣付款。公司表示擁有逾900萬用戶，業務遍及逾100個國家。
今年早前有報道指上市計劃因監管及法律問題有所延遲，當中涉及與幣安的訴訟。公司曾表示繼續與合作夥伴推進相關程序。
